summaries.POI-2026-0317A: Unidentified subject grouped under the reference Alder following recurring descriptions of outerwear and vehicle shape. The observations lack sufficient distinguishing detail to establish a common identity. Separate sightings remain unlinked pending comparison of the original descriptions.
summaries.POI-2026-0317B: Meridian is a working reference for observations involving recurring service-route timings. No driver has been identified. The timing similarities remain a comparison lead; they do not establish that the same person travelled the route or attended a particular address.
summaries.POI-ADL-CARE-W01: Home-support worker allocated to Resident A in Marion and Resident B in Oaklands Park. Assignment and directory entries identify the support role, while attendance and authorship of a retained message remain unverified. Resident B authorised a limited transport enquiry; no equivalent authority is recorded for Resident A.
summaries.POI-ADL-CARE-X01: Community-transport enquiry contact outside the allocated support team. A volunteered directory entry and corresponding account label relate to Resident B's enquiry. Account ownership and message authorship are unverified. No supplied record places Rowan at either dwelling or links Rowan to spending or missing property.
summaries.POI-FNET-DARNELL: Mobile associate described as maintaining contacts across several locations and carrying small items, messages or cash between them. A possible courier role in drug distribution is under consideration. The available account does not establish parcel contents, the purpose of a handover or knowledge of unlawful activity.
summaries.POI-FNET-ELIAS: Methodical associate with an interest in cash flow, informal payments and financial record keeping. A possible bookkeeping and resource-allocation role within a drug network remains unverified. The purpose and ownership of any funds require examination of the underlying payment records.
summaries.POI-FNET-MARA: Facilitator with contacts across community and business settings, described as arranging introductions, meetings and exchanges. Possible coordination of drug-network contacts is an unverified line of enquiry. The purpose of individual meetings remains unresolved; social contact alone does not establish participation.
summaries.POI-FNET-NOAH: Associate who maintains a low public profile and communicates across several social circles. Possible communications and logistics support functions have been raised, rather than direct handling of drugs or cash. The extent of involvement and knowledge of individual exchanges remain unverified.
summaries.POI-FNET-TESSA: Trusted associate with access to private social and residential settings. Possible responsibilities include administration, packaging, storage and financial reconciliation within a distribution network. These roles remain unverified; access to premises does not establish possession of stored items or control of a transaction.
summaries.POI-NBNW-CLARA: Philanthropist and co-director of Ochre East Foundation alongside George Kaplan. Her donor contacts and governance role are relevant to review of donations associated with gallery clients and subsequent grant distributions. Whether she knew of, authorised or benefited from any misuse of foundation funds remains unresolved.
summaries.POI-NBNW-EVE: Art consultant associated with George Kaplan's Alice Springs gallery, with a background involving resource-sector companies and client introductions. Matters for review include artwork provenance, high-value sales, travel overlap and the source of client funds. A role in moving illicit capital is alleged but has not been established.
summaries.POI-NBNW-GEORGE: Alice Springs art-gallery operator and co-director of Ochre East Foundation. Sales, resales and client donations involving Philip Vandamm, Eve Kendall and Clara Thornhill are relevant to a financial review. Pricing, provenance and payment timing warrant comparison; a laundering purpose has not been established.
summaries.POI-NBNW-PHILIP: International investor and major client of George Kaplan's gallery. Offshore structures, use of intermediaries, art purchases and travel to Alice Springs feature in the account under review. Possible layering of funds is a line of enquiry; ownership, control and the source of transaction funds remain to be established.
summaries.POI-V2-GEORGE: Applied-mathematics and sports-data specialist known as The Architect. Information under review raises possible connections between sports information and a drug-distribution network. The nature of those connections remains unverified, and his technical expertise does not establish involvement in a particular exchange.
summaries.POI-V2-JULIAN: Amsterdam-based technology-consultancy executive with business introductions and logistics contacts relevant to a counterfeit-goods enquiry. Possible involvement remains unverified. Control of goods, knowledge of their origin and authority over any particular shipment have not been established.
summaries.POI-V2-TONY: Former mathematician who operates a film-vehicle maintenance business and is described as a logistics broker. Known as Skids, his professional contacts span technical planning, vehicle work and transport. Possible logistics involvement remains unverified; vehicle access alone does not establish what was carried or his knowledge of it.
summaries.POI-V2-VIVIENNE: Business adviser and mentor to emerging entrepreneurs through a boutique consultancy. Her professional role provides context for introductions, meetings and business relationships with other named contacts. The available account does not establish involvement in their alleged activities.
